steps.title: Rep edits and sends; track which sections win
steps.what: The rep edited each draft (22 min, 31 min, 18 min) and sent it. A simulated win/loss log of 80 past proposals shows which sections move the win rate.
steps.code:
for s in sections:
    lift = win_rate(with s) - win_rate(without s)
keep = [s for s in sections if lift[s] >= 10]   # points
drop = [s for s in sections if lift[s] <= -10]

story.situation: An enterprise UCaaS sales team. Reps spend most of a day researching each account and building a proposal from scratch, and no two proposals look alike, so nobody can tell which parts actually win deals.
story.constraints: CRM access is read-only and goes through one MCP server, so IT can audit it. Every pain must cite a source the rep can check. ROI numbers come from a calculator, never from the model. The rep edits and sends; nothing goes to a buyer automatically.
story.replay: Reuse: 'Skill holds the playbook, MCP holds the data, code holds the numbers' fits any repeatable document: QBRs, renewal briefs, RFP answers. Next time: weight the pain scoring with the win/loss log, and add a 'thin evidence' check that blocks a pain with a single tech-stack source.
